From: jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com

Subject: Re: Draft MSA + Order Form — kickoff

Amara / Sofia — I reviewed the attachments at a high level and have captured the near-term redline asks. Quick notes (first-pass):

- Liability cap: propose Redwood's standard cap at 2x fees for the first 12 months, with carveouts for willful misconduct and data breach (we can provide language).
- Data residency: we need to ensure Exhibit A explicitly lists permitted processing locations (US/EU). If Vertex requires strict EU-only residency for certain data subsets, call that out now.
- SLA / credits: propose a 99.9% uptime target for hosted API with tiered credits; want to keep remedies limited to credits only.
- Indemnity: need mutual indemnities tied to IP infringement and narrow third-party claims; push back on broad customer indemnity language around security lapses.
- Subprocessors / logging: ask for list of subprocessors and retention periods; we generally require 30 days of requestable logs for investigations.

Timeline: I can produce a marked-up MSA and a redline summary by Wed 9/10 EOD PT as requested. I'll attach detailed comments.

Attachments: redline_comments_jonas.docx

- Payment terms: Redwood standard is net-30; we can agree to net-45 for enterprise procurement with a small commercial uplift (I will follow up with a short note). Markus, please confirm the uplift percentage and update the tracker.
- DocuSign: DocuSign is fine. Our preferred signer for commercial agreements is Silvia Huang, VP Finance — I will confirm title and email for the envelope.

Next steps / owners: 
- Jonas: deliver marked MSA redline + clause summary by Wed 9/10 EOD PT (owner: jonas.weber)
- Markus: confirm commercial uplift for net-45 and billing contact by Thu 9/11 AM PT (owner: markus.klein)
- Amara / Vertex: provide SOC 2 link or contact and confirm EU residency requirements (owner: Amara Singh)
- Sofia: prepare DocuSign envelope details and mutual action plan PDF — target Fri 9/12 (owner: sofia.ivanova)
